job.title: Software Engineer - Platform Engineering
job.workplace: not open to hires in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA or WA
job.pay_full: $108,720 – $159,900 a year, depending on location (ranges published for CO, HI, IL, MD, MA, MN, VT, DC, NY, NJ, WA and CA); may also be eligible for Twilio's equity and corporate bonus plans

details.about: Twilio provides communications tools used by hundreds of thousands of businesses and millions of developers, and is a remote-first company. This is an entry-level role (Software Development Engineer 1) on the Cloud Native Container Operations team, which helps operate, secure and modernize Twilio's shared Kubernetes platform, including its OTK, Segment and ZipWhip EKS fleets, across more than 1,000 Kubernetes clusters. It comes with structured mentorship from senior engineers and hands-on experience with modern automation tools.
duties: Help manage the lifecycle of cloud-hosted Kubernetes platforms that serve all of Twilio
Fix container and kernel-level CVE vulnerabilities to keep the shared platform secure
Write automation scripts in Go and Shell to streamline everyday cluster operations
Deploy infrastructure changes safely with senior engineers using Terraform and GitOps
Troubleshoot basic platform issues and apply the lessons to improve reliability
needs: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent practical training
Foundational programming in Go (Golang) and Shell scripting
Basic exposure to cloud environments, specifically AWS
Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and YAML
Academic or internship exposure to containers such as Docker or Kubernetes
Practical understanding of Git and core software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts
nice: Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools like ArgoCD
Basic understanding of networking, operating systems and distributed systems
Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) for coding or debugging
Strong problem-solving and an eagerness to learn complex infrastructure
details.benefits: Published pay ranges by location: $108,720 – $135,900 (Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland outside the DC area, Massachusetts, Minnesota or Vermont); $115,120 – $143,900 (New York and New Jersey outside the NYC area, Washington State outside the Seattle area, Washington DC and its area, Maryland, or California outside the SF Bay Area); $127,920 – $159,900 (SF Bay Area, NYC area or Seattle area). Ranges apply only to candidates in the listed states; pay elsewhere is discussed during hiring. The role may be eligible for Twilio's equity plan and corporate bonus plan. Benefits generally include health care insurance, a 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off and paid parental leave.
notes: Entry-level role (Software Development Engineer 1) with structured mentorship
Remote, but not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA or WA
In states where the role can be hired, the published ranges are $108,720 – $135,900 and, for Washington DC and Maryland, $115,120 – $143,900
Occasional travel for team or project meetings may be required
Applications are intended to be accepted until 11/25/2026, but this may change based on business needs
Twilio recruiters use @twilio.com email addresses and never ask for payment or banking details
